fit_timing: Every monthly fit uses strictly completed prior weeks. Earlier completed weeks within the evaluation period may enter subsequent rolling fits.
comparison: Same nine state inputs, seven actions, source bandits, 104-week window, minimum 52 weeks, costs, and single capital budget for all four preferences.
display: Four requested operating points span risk preference. They do not replace or claim to be the original validation winner; its selection record is preserved in reports/signal_allocation_discount/selection.json.
training_counterfactuals: Seven prior allocations crossed with seven actions share each market week; not independent observations.
convergence: 81 monthly fits at 200, 500, 1000, 2000 updates; identical evaluation-period actions for every checked preference.
